"""RoboTwin dump_bin_bigbin episode controller and action record.
Run: python /app/output/gen.py '<JSON with ee or joint actions, optional note>'
Every call saves its camera views and metadata under /app/runs.
"""
import sys, json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
RUNS=pathlib.Path('/app/runs'); RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
if len(sys.argv)>1:
    request=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); kind=request.get('type','ee_pose')
    actions=request['actions']; note=request.get('note','')
    result=r.submit(kind, actions, dt=request.get('dt',0.05), video='frames', cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),note=note)
    entry={'type':kind,'actions':actions,'dt':request.get('dt',0.05),'note':note,'meta':{k:v for k,v in result.meta.items() if k not in ('cameras','proprio')}}
    with (RUNS/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n')
else:
    result=r.get_obs(cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),include_depth=True)
idx=len(list(RUNS.glob('step_*')))
folder=RUNS/f'step_{idx:03d}'
result.save(folder)
print('STEP',idx,'META',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.meta.items() if k not in ('cameras','proprio')}))
if 'proprio' in result.meta: print('PROPRIO',json.dumps(result.meta['proprio']['now']))
ims=list(result.last.items()); montage=Image.new('RGB',(960,480)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(montage)
for i,(name,im) in enumerate(ims):
 x=(i%3)*320;y=(i//3)*240;montage.paste(Image.fromarray(im),(x,y));d.text((x+2,y+2),name,fill='red')
montage.save(folder/'montage.png')
PY
